normalization: edgeR TMM; limma-voom with duplicateCorrelation blocking on person
design_formula: ~ study_day + timepoint; person-level repeated-measures correlation blocked by subject_id
multiple_testing: Primary BH across all genes times three planned contrasts; pathways form a separate family; within-contrast q retained

reactome_snapshot.release_status: Legacy package snapshot frozen as exact gene-set file; not relabeled as current Reactome release

pathway_analysis: fgsea ranked by limma moderated t statistic; Reactome annotation versions recorded through package lock
interpretation_limit: Five independent people, with repeated samples across three study days and three timepoints. The contrast estimates a whole-blood response to a mixed high-fat challenge and cannot identify the causal effect of a single food component. No individual response or health-risk prediction is produced.
